errors.text_span: Четвъртият сектор, в тъмносив цвят, е „Природен газ“ с 0.2%, а най-малкият сектор, в светлосив цвят, е „Твърди горива“ с 0.4%.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the ranks of the two smallest sectors. The fourth largest sector is "Твърди горива" (Solid fuels) with 0.4%, while the smallest sector is "Природен газ" (Natural gas) with 0.2%.

The description identifies the color of the "Твърди горива" (Solid fuels) slice as light gray ("светлосив"), but it is a dark blueish-gray in the chart. The slice for "Природен газ" is dark gray/black.

errors.text_span: Секторите са визуално подредени по низходящ ред на големината им
errors.evidence: The description claims that the sectors are visually arranged in descending order of size. However, the clockwise arrangement starting from the top is 0.4%, 76.9%, 0.2%, 4.0%, and 18.5%, which is not a descending order.
This part of the sentence repeats the error of identifying "Твърди горива" (Solid fuels) as the smallest sector. The smallest sector is "Природен газ" (Natural gas) at 0.2%.
